title: Asks you to buy gift cards
why: Gift card codes can be spent instantly and cannot be traced. 'Your boss' asking for them in a hurry is a well-known fraud.
examples: I'm in a meeting. Buy 5 Amazon gift cards and send the codes here, I will pay you back.
Are you free? Need a quick favour, urgent gift cards for a client.
safe: I bought you a gift card for your birthday.
Amazon gift card of Rs 500 has been added to your account.
